market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a volatile 1-3 month window. Oil at $100 and US-Iran escalation create upside risk for energy but downside for broad equities. Rising Treasury yields and disappointing fiscal policy (Bessent) pressure rate-sensitive sectors. Inflation data this week is the critical catalyst—hot prints could push 10Y yields above 5%, triggering further equity selloffs. Dollar weakness at 7-month low supports EM but disrupts carry trades. Dow's 500-point drop signals risk-off rotation. Expect 5-8% volatility in S&P 500 over next 6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive but bifurcated. Energy and commodity supercycle (copper ATH, diesel tightness, China demand) supports resource equities. Apple foldable cycle and AI infrastructure (despite delays) drive tech leadership. Trade war fragmentation (US-Canada, US-Iran) accelerates supply chain reshoring, benefiting domestic manufacturers. Social Security solvency concerns and rising insurance/housing costs create structural headwinds for consumer discretionary. BYD 2.5M export target and EV adoption support auto sector. Key risk: if US-Iran conflict escalates beyond tanker attacks, oil could spike to $120+, triggering recessionary fears.
